lines.en: label dormwartwo8:
scene comedywaragain1
: Sir, either cloak yourself or get out of the way. The Kendo Princess is about to make her comedy debut and I owe it to her to pretend it’s hilarious.
lines.zh: : 先生，要么把你那身斗篷披上，要么让开。剑道公主马上要献上她的喜剧首秀了，我欠她一个人情，得假装那很好笑。

lines.en: : I have never seen a live comedian before. The only real experience I have with comedy is when Penemue puts rocks in my shoes.
lines.zh: : 我从来没看过现场的喜剧演员。我对喜剧唯一的真实体验，就是 Penemue 往我鞋子里放石头的时候。

lines.en: : I was just going to ask if I can sit here. No one else cares about me anymore.
lines.zh: : 我只是想问问能不能坐这儿。已经没有别人在乎我了。

lines.en: : I know at least one entity that will always care about you. All you must do is-
lines.zh: : 我知道至少有一个存在永远会在乎你。你只需要——

lines.en: : Yes, fine. Sit. We can experience this moment together as it hopefully brings our floor one step closer to a legendary loot drop in the form of your body.
lines.zh: : 行，好吧。坐吧。我们可以一起经历这一刻——希望它能让我们楼层离一件传奇战利品更近一步，而那件战利品的形式，就是你的身体。

lines.en: : Legendary, huh?
lines.zh: : 传奇，是吗？

lines.en: : I said what I said. Now sit or I’ll have Yasu cast Shadow Word: Death on you.
lines.zh: : 我说出口的话就不会收回。现在坐下，不然我就让 Yasu 对你施放「暗言术：灭」。

lines.en: scene black
scene comedywaragain2
: Hello, everyone. My name is Tsuneyo Tojo. But at least seven of you know me by the name Ram.
lines.zh: : 大家好。我叫 Tsuneyo Tojo。不过你们当中至少有七个人，知道我另一个名字——Ram。

lines.en: : And before you ask, no. I’m not talking about the sheep.
lines.zh: : 在你们开口问之前先说清楚，不是。我说的不是那只公羊。

lines.en: : Jesus, Mary, and Joseph- I’m already knackered.
lines.zh: : 耶稣、玛利亚和约瑟啊——我已经累坏了。

lines.en: : Is it over? Did she do the comedy?
lines.zh: : 结束了吗？她把喜剧讲完了吗？

lines.en: scene comedywaragain3
: It is at this point that I will attempt to tell more jokes.
lines.zh: : 那么接下来，我要试着再讲几个笑话。

lines.en: : More? Has she told any yet?
lines.zh: : 再讲？她到现在讲过吗？

lines.en: : I think the sheep thing was-
lines.zh: : 我觉得那个公羊的梗——

lines.en: : Shh. Silence is the key to...eternity.
lines.zh: : 嘘。沉默是通往……永恒的关键。

lines.en: : You know, I’ve come a long way since enrolling at Kumon-mi High.
lines.zh: : 你们知道吗，自从入学 Kumon-mi 学园以来，我已经走了很远。

lines.en: : It feels like just the other day, I was happily strangling animals in my backyard- hoping for the opportunity to find someone else to strangle animals with one day.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像是不久之前，我还在自家后院开心地掐死小动物——盼望着有一天能找到另一个人，陪我一起掐死小动物。

lines.en: : But now, I know all sorts of things.
lines.zh: : 但现在，我懂各种各样的东西了。

lines.en: : Like how to do low level algebra...
lines.zh: : 比如怎么做低阶代数……

lines.en: : And what it means to be sexually harassed.
lines.zh: : 还有，被性骚扰是什么意思。

lines.en: Surprisingly, a few people actually laugh at that.
lines.zh: 出人意料的是，居然真的有几个人笑了。

lines.en: And unsurprisingly, everyone looks directly at me right after.
lines.zh: 而毫不意外的是，紧接着所有人都直直地看向了我。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain4
: It feels like just the other day when the only thing that mattered to me was noodles. And, while that is still true today, there have been several moments in time in which I have questioned that.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像是不久之前，我唯一在乎的东西还是面条。虽然今天这一点依然成立，但也有过好几个瞬间，让我对这件事产生了怀疑。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, all of those moments have come at the cost of great humiliation as I have consistently wowed you all with my lack of knowledge about everything not made of wheat.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，那些瞬间全都是以巨大的羞辱为代价换来的——我一次次用「对一切不是小麦做的东西都一无所知」，惊艳了你们所有人。

lines.en: : You see, beneath the surface, I’m just like the rest of you.
lines.zh: : 你们看，在表面之下，我和你们其余的人没什么两样。

lines.en: : Perhaps my interests are a little...what’s the word...{i}better.{/i} But I still want many of the same things you do.
lines.zh: : 也许我的兴趣有点……那个词怎么说来着……{i}更高。{/i}但我想要的东西，和你们想要的还是有很多一样的。

lines.en: : I want to find my place in the world.
lines.zh: : 我想在这个世界上找到自己的位置。

lines.en: : I want to have a fun high school life.
lines.zh: : 我想过一段有趣的高中生活。

lines.en: : But even more importantly than that-
lines.zh: : 但比这些更重要的是——

lines.en: scene comedywaragain5
: I want to know why the school nurse always has Friday off.
lines.zh: : 我想知道，为什么学校的保健老师星期五总是休息。

lines.en: : Oi, oi, oi! We’re startin’ to get somewhere, Sir! That joke actually landed with a few people!
lines.zh: : 喂，喂，喂！我们开始有点门道了，先生！那个笑话真的炸到了几个人！

lines.en: : And brings up a great point that I don’t think has ever been addressed before.
lines.zh: : 而且还提出了一个很妙的点，我觉得以前从来没人提过。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, there are a lot of things about our school that don’t particularly make sense.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我们学校有很多事情其实都不太说得通。

lines.en: : And that means a lot coming from me as, up until recently, I’d learned everything in the corner of a restaurant surrounded by hungry Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 这话由我来说分量可不轻，因为直到不久之前，我还一直是在一家餐馆的角落里、被一群饿着肚子的黑帮分子围着，学会这一切的。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain6

: Of course I’m not the only one in our school with ties to such people. But, considering I had to carry that girl out of class recently, I think the likelihood of her chiming in on this topic is very low.
lines.zh: : 当然，我们学校里和这种人有牵扯的不止我一个。不过考虑到我最近不得不把那个女孩从教室里抱出去，我觉得她插话聊这个话题的可能性非常低。

lines.en: : Just not as low as Miku’s grades.
lines.zh: : 只是没低到 Miku 的成绩那么低。

lines.en: : HA!
: Wha- Tsuneyo?!
lines.zh: : 什——Tsuneyo？！

lines.en: : Please laugh now, as I believe that is what they call a “roast.”
lines.zh: : 现在请笑吧，因为我相信这就是他们所说的「吐槽炸弹」。

lines.en: : This is...actually going kind of well.
lines.zh: : 这……其实还挺顺利的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be fine, Ayane. Don’t let it get to you.
lines.zh: : 我相信你不会有事的，Ayane。别往心里去。

lines.en: : Why...isn’t Tsuneyo...ever like this...when we play D&D?...
lines.zh: : 为什么……我们玩龙与地下城的时候……Tsuneyo 从来不是这样的……

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : It’s almost like she’s a different person all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 简直就像她突然变成了另一个人……

lines.en: scene comedywaragain7
: The amount of memories I’ve made at Kumon-mi High is greater than I could have ever asked for. And none of that would be possible if it were not for our amazing teacher...
lines.zh: : 我在 Kumon-mi 学园留下的回忆，比我敢奢求的还要多。而如果不是因为我们那位了不起的老师，这一切都不可能……

lines.en: : Imani Imai.
lines.zh: : Imani Imai。

lines.en: : YEAAAAH! CHOCOLATE BUNNY!!!
lines.zh: : 耶————！巧克力兔女郎！！！

lines.en: : Imani has been very kind to me since the moment she arrived at our school.
lines.zh: : 从她来到我们学校的那一刻起，Imani 就一直对我很好。

lines.en: : And while I would like to believe it’s because she sees through my awkwardness to the good in my heart...I think the real reason is that she’s just secretly racist.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想相信，那是因为她看穿了我的笨拙、看到了我内心的善良……但我觉得真正的原因是，她只是暗地里是个种族主义者。

lines.en: : BOOOO! CHOCOLATE BUNNY!!!
lines.zh: : 嘘————！巧克力兔女郎！！！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain2
: Fortunately, our collection of flaws is what makes our school so unique. Each one of us has something different and horrible to offer...but something nice to counteract it.
lines.zh: : 幸运的是，正是我们这堆缺点让这所学校如此独特。我们每个人都有某种不同且可怕的东西可以提供……但也有某种美好的东西来抵消它。

lines.en: : For example, Ami’s flaws are her high pitched voice and reliance on her uncle. But she makes up for it with her amazing thighs.
lines.zh: : 比如说，Ami 的缺点是她那尖细的嗓音和对她叔叔的依赖。但她用那双了不起的大腿弥补了这一点。

lines.en: : Thank you!...I think?
lines.zh: : 谢谢！……大概吧？

lines.en: : And Chika is one of the nicest people I have ever met. However, she purchased the last yakisoba bread from the school store while I was behind her in line one day and I have not yet forgiven her for it.
lines.zh: : 还有 Chika，是我见过最善良的人之一。不过有一天，她在学校小卖部买走了最后一个炒面面包，而我就排在她后面，我到现在都还没原谅她。

lines.en: : Wait, I did? When? I don’t even like yakisoba bread.
lines.zh: : 等等，我买过吗？什么时候？我根本就不喜欢炒面面包啊。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain3
: You should remember, you bitch.
lines.zh: : 你应该记得的，你这个贱人。

lines.en: : Woah!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！

lines.en: : Just kidding.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: : You see, the best part about stand-up comedy is that I’m able to say all sorts of things like that and no one is allowed to take any of it seriously.
lines.zh: : 你看，单口相声最棒的地方就在于，我可以把这种话都说出来，而谁都不许把它当真。

lines.en: : Which is why my next several jokes will be based entirely around the time I found my best friend passed out with semen all over her while our {i}real{/i} teacher stood there menacingly staring down at her.
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我接下来的几个笑话，会全部围绕那一天——我发现我最好的朋友昏倒在地、浑身是精液，而我们{i}真正{/i}的老师就站在那儿不怀好意地低头盯着她。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain8
: Knock knock.
lines.zh: : 咚，咚。

lines.en: : I said knock knock. Someone is supposed to say “Who is there?”
lines.zh: : 我说了咚，咚。这时候应该有人说「是谁啊？」

lines.en: : Wait...Tsuneyo, you can’t tell jokes like-
lines.zh: : 等等……Tsuneyo，你不能讲这种——

lines.en: : Who’s there, Tsuneyo?!
lines.zh: : 是谁啊，Tsuneyo？！

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : 老师。

lines.en: : Sensei who?!
lines.zh: : 老师谁？！

lines.en: : Stupid girl. I am a predator and you should have locked the door as soon as I announced my presence.
lines.zh: : 蠢丫头。我是个捕食者，我宣布到来的时候，你就该把门锁上。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain9
: Knock knock again.
lines.zh: : 再咚，咚。

lines.en: : This stand-up routine went from decently okay to flat out weird really fucking fast.
lines.zh: : 这段单口相声从「还算可以」直接变成「彻底诡异」，速度快得他妈吓人。

lines.en: : Cut it out. I won’t let you stand up there and-
lines.zh: : 够了。我不会让你站在上面——

lines.en: : Who’s there?!
lines.zh: : 是谁啊？！

lines.en: : Kirin...
lines.zh: : Kirin……

lines.en: : Molly.
lines.zh: : Molly。

lines.en: : Molly who?!
lines.zh: : Molly 谁？！

lines.en: : Molly MacCormack. She’s unconscious and filthy, so I felt compelled to carry her to safety after the last man who knocked on your door had his way with her.
lines.zh: : Molly MacCormack。她昏过去了，而且浑身脏兮兮的，所以在上一个敲你门的男人对她为所欲为之后，我觉得自己有义务把她带到安全的地方。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain10
: Knock knock.
lines.zh: : 咚，咚。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Who’s-
lines.zh: : 是谁——

lines.en: : Okay! Give it up for Tsuneyo, everybody! It was a great first attempt up until the very end!
lines.zh: : 好了！让我们为 Tsuneyo 鼓掌，各位！直到最后一刻之前，这都是一次很棒的初次尝试！

lines.en: : Wait. I still have more material that I would like to-
lines.zh: : 等等。我还有一些段子想——

lines.en: : Nope! Time’s up! But...great try! Tsuneyo, everybody!
lines.zh: : 不行！时间到了！不过……表现很棒！Tsuneyo，各位！

lines.en: : Uhh...s...see what I said? I told you you didn’t have to worry!
lines.zh: : 呃……看……看吧，我说什么来着？我说了你不用担心的！

lines.en: : Boy, stand-up comedy sure is inappropriate now...right, Ayane?!
lines.zh: : 天哪，现在的单口相声可真是不合时宜啊……对吧，Ayane？！

lines.en: : Uhh...Ayane?
lines.zh: : 呃……Ayane？

lines.en: : You know...she was just joking...right?...
lines.zh: : 你知道的……她只是开玩笑……对吧？……

lines.en: : I know you...care a lot about Sensei, so...that probably hurt to hear, but...it’s all just...in good fun...
lines.zh: : 我知道你……很在乎老师，所以……听到那些大概很伤人，不过……那都只是……闹着玩的……

lines.en: : He’d never...actually do anything like that...right?
lines.zh: : 他绝不会……真的做出那种事的……对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah, of course not. He’d never.
lines.zh: : 嗯。嗯，当然不会。他绝不会。

lines.en: : That was just a joke. An...extremely raunchy and inappropriate joke...from Tsuneyo...who doesn’t really grasp...normal...social...conduct...
lines.zh: : 那只是个玩笑。一个……极其下流又不合时宜的玩笑……来自 Tsuneyo……她其实不太懂……正常的……社交……礼仪……

lines.en: : Ayane, are you ready to go? Things are really awkward all of a sudden and you’re the only one who can put an end to it.
lines.zh: : Ayane，你准备好上了吗？气氛突然变得特别尴尬，只有你能结束这一切。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain11
: I’m...the only one...
lines.zh: : 我是……唯一的那个……

lines.en: : That’s right...
lines.zh: : 没错……

lines.en: : I’m the only one.
lines.zh: : 我是唯一的那个。

lines.en: : You’ve got this. Knock em dead or...break a leg or...whatever it is you’re supposed to say to stand-up comics.
lines.zh: : 你能行的。炸翻全场，或者……祝你好运，或者……管它对单口相声演员该说什么来着。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane takes the stage.
lines.zh: Ayane 走上舞台。

lines.en: That’s all I want to narrate right now.
lines.zh: 此刻我只想叙述到这里。

lines.en: : Ayane!
lines.zh: : Ayane！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain13
: Huh?
: Tell some fucking jokes!
lines.zh: : 讲点他妈的笑话啊！

lines.en: : Woo! Ayane! Bring home the easy win!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Ayane！把这场稳赢的胜利拿下！

lines.en: : Yeah! And don’t make things extremely awkward and inappropriate like Tsuneyo did!
lines.zh: : 对！而且别像 Tsuneyo 那样把气氛搞得又尴尬又不合时宜！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain14
: I believe in you! And not just because Sana lost and you’re all I have left!
lines.zh: : 我相信你！而且不只是因为 Sana 输了、你是我唯一剩下的希望！

lines.en: : And I....yeah! Me too!
lines.zh: : 而我……呃，对！我也是！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain15
Ayane looks at me.
lines.zh: Ayane 看着我。

lines.en: And I fight away the shame I’m feeling to look back at her.
lines.zh: 我压下心中的羞耻，回看向她。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain16
: Hah...
: Business as usual.
lines.zh: : 老样子。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain17
: Alright! Who’s ready to hear some material that won’t end with everybody feeling like they have to wash their hands?!
lines.zh: : 好了！谁准备好听一些不会让所有人最后都觉得自己得去洗手的段子了？！

lines.en: : Assuming I’m able to hold myself back from using this stage as a platform to once again express my love for Sensei, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是我能忍住，不把这个舞台当成又一次表达我对老师的爱的平台。

lines.en: : But if there’s anything you all know about me by now, it’s that I’m fine with just living in my fantasies about him. And that I’ve been doing that since day one at Kumon-mi High.
lines.zh: : 不过要说你们现在对我有什么了解，那就是我光是活在对他的幻想里就已经很满足了。而且从我进 Kumon-mi 学园的第一天起，我就一直是这么做的。

lines.en: : And that I’m only {i}kind of{/i} wishing that I were an unconscious, semen-covered body on his bedroom floor right now.
lines.zh: : 还有，我只是{i}有点{/i}希望，此刻我就是他卧室地板上那具昏迷不醒、浑身是精液的身体。

lines.en: : Ugh, don’t you girls know how to joke about anything else?!
lines.zh: : 呃，你们这些女孩除了这个就不会开点别的玩笑了吗？！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain18
: I kid, I kid. There’s a time and place for jokes like that and I can assure you that it’s not in front of a room full of my friends.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑，开玩笑。那种笑话是有时间和场合的，我可以保证，绝不是当着一屋子我朋友的面。

lines.en: : Not because I don’t think you’ll enjoy it, but because I am far too selfish to risk the chance of that semen landing on anyone else.
lines.zh: : 不是因为我觉得你们不会喜欢，而是因为我太自私了，绝不能冒那个险，让那些精液落到别人身上。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain19
: But that’s enough about semen!
lines.zh: : 不过关于精液就到此为止！

lines.en: : Best news I’ve heard all year.
lines.zh: : 这是我今年听过最好的消息。

lines.en: : {i}Worst{/i} news I’ve heard all year.
lines.zh: : 这是我今年听过{i}最糟{/i}的消息。

lines.en: : The reason we’re gathered here today, ignoring the obvious answer of the six-foot tall grand prize, is-
lines.zh: : 今天我们聚在这里的理由——先忽略那个显而易见的答案，也就是那个六英尺高的大奖——是——

lines.en: scene comedywaragain20
: Actually, I think that’s it. That’s the only thing we all have in common.
lines.zh: : 其实，我想就是那个了。那是我们所有人唯一的共同点。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain21

: Guess that’s that, then! Since the only thing keeping us bound together is our shared desire to sleep in the same room as an adult male, I no longer feel comfortable delivering a semen-free set and must resign!
lines.zh: : 那就这样吧！既然唯一把我们绑在一起的，是我们想和一个成年男性睡在同一间房里的共同愿望，那我已经没法安心讲一段不含精液的段子了，我必须退赛！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain22
: Or at least that’s what I {i}should{/i} be doing. Especially since I have a proven history of being overly confident on stage just moments before being utterly decimated.
lines.zh: : 至少我本{i}该{/i}这么做。尤其是考虑到我一向有这种前科——在台上自信过头，然后下一秒就被彻底碾碎。

lines.en: : But thankfully, Uta isn’t allowed to speak like a normal human being until tomorrow night! Which means that, this time, my greatest nemesis is myself.
lines.zh: : 不过谢天谢地，Uta 在明天晚上之前不许像正常人那样说话！也就是说，这一次我最大的敌人是我自己。

lines.en: : Oh, and also Tsuneyo- who was able to get a full three jokes out before setting her entire set ablaze.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有 Tsuneyo——她成功讲完了整整三个笑话，然后就把自己整段表演付之一炬。

lines.en: : But, hey! She set a new personal record in the process as I’m pretty sure I heard at least two people laughing at once to a couple of them...and I’m not sure if she’s ever accomplished that before.
lines.zh: : 不过，嘿！她在这个过程中还创下了个人新纪录——我敢肯定其中有几个笑话至少让两个人同时笑了出来……我不确定她以前做到过没有。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain23
: Now, I’m not claiming to be funnier than her or anything. In fact, I have just about as much experience with stand-up comedy as Chika has with buttoning her shirt up all the way.
lines.zh: : 现在，我可没有说我比她好笑什么的。事实上，我在单口相声方面的经验，大概就和 Chika 把衬衫扣子全部扣上的经验一样多。

lines.en: : But it’s {i}okay{/i} if I’m not funny. Because all that matters is the amount of {i}heart{/i} I put into this.
lines.zh: : 不过不好笑也{i}没关系{/i}。因为唯一重要的是我在这里面倾注了多少{i}真心{/i}。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain24
: And also the fact that I have finally capitalized on my position in society and paid off the judges.
lines.zh: : 还有，我终于利用起了自己的社会地位，把评委们贿赂了一遍。

lines.en: : Thanks, Dad. I understand now that all of those years of neglect were simply to prepare me for...earning my team one point in a contest that we were probably going to win anyway.
lines.zh: : 谢了，爸爸。我现在明白了，那些年对我的忽视，只是为了让我做好准备……在一场我们大概本来就会赢的比赛里，为我的队伍挣到一分。

lines.en: : Th...That’s just what you think! The second floor will still prevail!
lines.zh: : 那……那只是你以为！二楼还是会赢的！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain25
: Hey, everybody! Molly finally woke up! Welcome back to Kumon-mi and make sure to change your clothes. Rumors are starting to spread.
lines.zh: : 嘿，各位！Molly 终于醒了！欢迎回到 Kumon-mi，记得换身衣服。谣言已经开始传了。

lines.en: : Jokes aside, which is probably not a thing I should be saying during a stand-up set, I really love you girls on the second floor.
lines.zh: : 玩笑归玩笑——这句话大概不该在单口相声表演里说——我真的很爱二楼的你们这些女孩。

lines.en: : Especially since all of you are of absolutely no threat to me when it comes to my endless pursuit of the one thing I love-
lines.zh: : 尤其是因为，在我无尽地追求我唯一钟爱之物的路上，你们所有人都对我构不成任何威胁——

lines.en: scene comedywaragain26
: A clean shower.
lines.zh: : 一间干净的淋浴间。

lines.en: : Hey, our shower is clean!
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们的淋浴间很干净！

lines.en: : It’s really not. I’ve been meaning to say something about it for quite some time but I didn’t want to be a bother.
lines.zh: : 真的一点都不干净。这件事我早就想说了，只是不想惹人烦。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain19
: Come to think of it, I can’t really imagine a better set of girls to spend the rest of my apparently eternal life with than all of you on the first floor!
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我真的想不出比一楼的你们更适合陪我度过这显然永无止境的余生的女孩了！

lines.en: : Oh man, is Ayane’s set about to take a really weird turn now too? I’m actually enjoying this.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪，Ayane 的段子现在也要开始往奇怪的方向跑了吗？我还挺喜欢看的。

lines.en: : Yeah, because your floor is being complimented and mine is being trashed.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为被夸的是你们楼层，被踩的是我们楼层。

lines.en: : Well, we’re the better floor. What else would you expect?
lines.zh: : 嗯，因为我们本来就是更好的那层。你还指望什么？

lines.en: : My roommate is quiet and adorable...my childhood friend is right across the hall...
lines.zh: : 我的室友安静又可爱……我的青梅竹马就住在走廊对面……

lines.en: : And I can only {i}kind of{/i} hear Rin moaning when she and Otoha are making out in her room.
lines.zh: : 而且 Rin 和 Otoha 在她房间里亲热的时候，我只能{i}勉强{/i}听见一点 Rin 的呻吟。

lines.en: : Hey! She mentioned us!
lines.zh: : 嘿！她提到我们了！

lines.en: : Not in a good way!
lines.zh: : 可不是什么好话！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain27
: The fact of the matter is that I’ve got a lot to be thankful for. And that only half of it will wind up being repossessed when Touka’s family ultimately runs mine out of business.
lines.zh: : 事实是，我有很多值得感恩的东西。而当 Touka 家最终把我家的生意挤垮时，其中只有一半会被收走。

lines.en: : Hahah! Yes, we do that sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！对，我们偶尔是干得出来。

lines.en: : From my lifelong friends...to the brand new ones I’ve made in this SUSPICIOUSLY LONG SCHOOL YEAR...
lines.zh: : 从我那些一辈子的老朋友……到在这个「长得可疑」的学年里新交的朋友……

lines.en: : It’s like there’s a reminder every day that I’ve got it made.
lines.zh: : 就好像每天都有个提醒，告诉我我已经什么都有了。

lines.en: : And that everything I {i}don’t{/i} have is easily obtainable.
lines.zh: : 而我还{i}没有{/i}的东西，也都唾手可得。

lines.en: : And that goes for not just me-
lines.zh: : 而且这不只是对我成立——

lines.en: : But for {i}anyone{/i} willing to spend a few minutes on their knees in Sensei’s office between 3:00 and 4:00 every weekday.
lines.zh: : 对{i}任何{/i}愿意在每个工作日下午三点到四点之间、在老师的办公室里跪上几分钟的人，也都成立。

lines.en: : Okay! And that about wraps it up for Ayane as well! One last round of applause please, everyone! Woohoo!
lines.zh: : 好了！Ayane 的部分也差不多到此为止！请大家再给一轮掌声！呜呼！

lines.en: : Thank you, New York! You guys have been great!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，纽约！你们太棒了！

lines.en: : Sir...
lines.zh: : 先生……

lines.en: : Please don’t let this form another rift between us.
lines.zh: : 请不要让这件事在我们之间再撕开一道裂痕。

lines.en: : You must believe me when I say I had absolutely no idea the Kendo Princess was going to bring that up. I was just as shocked as you.
lines.zh: : 请你一定要相信我，我完全不知道剑道公主会提起那件事。我和你一样震惊。

lines.en: : Nothing will change between us. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我们之间什么都不会变。别担心。

lines.en: : But, Sir. I {i}have{/i} to worry when-
lines.zh: : 可是，先生。我{i}不得不{/i}担心——

lines.en: : Senpai.
lines.zh: : 前辈。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain28
: Ayane has to win. Tsuneyo got too weird. That shit don’t fly.
lines.zh: : Ayane 必须赢。Tsuneyo 太诡异了。那套玩意儿可不行。

lines.en: : Thank you for cutting her off.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你把她打断。

lines.en: : Hey, I didn’t do it just for you. I did it for everyone. I haven’t been in a room {i}that{/i} unanimously uncomfortable since the last pyramid scheme I got sucked into.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可不是只为了你。我是为了所有人。自从上次被卷进那个金字塔骗局之后，我就没待在过一个大家一致感到{i}那么{/i}不舒服的房间里。

lines.en: : What, you all laughed out or something? What’s got you so down?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，你们都笑累了还是怎么的？什么事让你这么低落？

lines.en: : Come sit on momma Imani’s lap and tell her all about your troubles.
lines.zh: : 来坐到 Imani 妈妈腿上，把你的烦恼都说给她听。

lines.en: : I’d offer to sit on yours as an alternative, but these tights have a few holes in them around the crotchular region and I’m not ready to have a third child.
lines.zh: : 按理说我也可以反过来坐你腿上，不过这条连裤袜在裆部那块有几个洞，我还没准备好要第三个孩子。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine in a minute. Just go deliver the news.
lines.zh: : 我一会儿就好了。你去宣布结果吧。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain29
: Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : But if you’re still like this during the next competition, I might have to take some drastic measures and cheer you up the old fashioned way.
lines.zh: : 不过要是下一场比赛你还是这副样子，我可能就得采取点极端手段，用老办法让你高兴起来了。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么做都行。

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...
: Okay! Ayane and Tsuneyo to the stage, please! Deliberations have ended and we are ready to announce the winner of the stand-up showdown!
lines.zh: : 好了！请 Ayane 和 Tsuneyo 上台！评审已经结束，我们准备宣布这场单口对决的获胜者了！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain30
: It was a hard fought battle that was...significantly more awkward than I expected it to be, but in a completely different way than I anticipated!
lines.zh: : 这是一场苦战，而且……比我预想的要尴尬得多，但尴尬的方式又和我预想的完全不同！

lines.en: : But we can walk away knowing that most of us laughed at least several times! And that any of us who didn’t...are probably named Io.
lines.zh: : 不过我们离开时至少可以确信，我们大多数人都笑了好几次！而没笑的那些人……大概都叫 Io 吧。

lines.en: : Accurate.
lines.zh: : 说得很对。

lines.en: : That being said...
lines.zh: : 话虽如此……

lines.en: scene comedywaragain31
: The winner...
lines.zh: : 获胜者是……

lines.en: : Of tonight’s contest...
lines.zh: : 今晚这场比赛的……

lines.en: scene comedywaragain32
: Is Ayane Amamiya! Give it up, everyone!
lines.zh: : 是 Ayane Amamiya！大家掌声鼓励！

lines.en: : I knew knock knock jokes were a bad idea. I will improve.
lines.zh: : 我就知道咚咚敲门笑话是个坏主意。我会改进的。

lines.en: : I...don’t think that was the problem, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得问题出在那儿，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Touka! Do the thing!
lines.zh: : Touka！做那件事！

lines.en: scene comedywaragain33
: Oh, I’ve always wanted to do this! I’m so excited! It’s like {i}I’ve{/i} won as well!
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}我{/i}一直都想这么做！我太兴奋了！感觉就像我自己也赢了一样！

lines.en: : I knew this day was not permanently avoidable. I accept my fate.
lines.zh: : 我就知道这一天终究躲不过去。我接受我的命运。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaaaaaaand...
scene comedywaragain34
: Yoink!
lines.zh: : 噗啾！

lines.en: : Ayane, this is the part where I’d normally like to give you a moment to speak out and address or thank everyone...
lines.zh: : Ayane，按理说这个时候我应该给你一点时间，让你说几句、致辞或者感谢大家……

lines.en: : But, due to budget constraints, we’ve gotta head to the next contest ASAP or the name won’t make sense anymore and one of our sponsors will drop out.
lines.zh: : 不过，由于预算有限，我们得尽快赶去下一场比赛，不然这个名字就讲不通了，我们的一位赞助商也会撤资。

lines.en: : Actually, uh...Imani?
lines.zh: : 其实，呃……Imani？

lines.en: scene comedywaragain35
: Oh no. That’s the “I need something” voice, isn’t it? What is it? Bus fare? Because I’m broke as fuck.
lines.zh: : 哦不。这是那种「我有事求你」的声音，对吧？什么事？车费？因为我他妈穷得要死。

lines.en: : And I’m rich.
lines.zh: : 而我有钱。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. Just rub it in, why don’t you? Real nice, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 哦，行啊。你就使劲往我伤口上撒盐吧，为什么不呢？真是太好了，Ayane。

lines.en: : I was just...going to ask if maybe I could be with Sensei alone for a little while? I’ll have a driver pick him up and hurry him to the next contest as soon as we’re done.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想问，能不能让我和老师单独待一会儿？我们一结束，我就让司机来接他，赶紧把他送到下一场比赛去。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain36

: Ayane, I know you must be dying to celebrate your victory with a nice beef injection, but I’ve gotta say, you picked a pretty bad time. And I don’t really know if Senpai’s feeling it right now either.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我知道你肯定急着想用一记美味的「牛肉注射」来庆祝胜利，不过我得说，你挑的时机真不怎么样。而且我也不太确定前辈现在有没有那个心情。

lines.en: : I just...wanted to talk to him. He made a promise to do something for me if I won and...I feel like if I don’t do anything about that now...I probably never will.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想和他谈谈。他答应过我，如果我赢了就为我做一件事，而且……我觉得如果现在不做点什么的话……我大概永远都不会做了。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain37
: Hah...fine. But if the PDA pulls their funding, I’m having them reach out to {i}your{/i} people since mine don’t speak Japanese.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧。不过如果 PDA 撤资，我就让他们去找{i}你{/i}的人，因为我的人不会说日语。

lines.en: : Listen up! Everyone not named Ayane or...whatever Senpai’s name is...get the fuck out!
lines.zh: : 都听好了！所有不叫 Ayane 的，还有……不管前辈叫什么名字的……都他妈给我滚出去！

lines.en: : Uhh...I kind of {i}own{/i} this place, so...
lines.zh: : 呃……这地方算是{i}我的{/i}，所以……

lines.en: : It involves an important victory promise between the two people I named! So even if you own the place, if your name isn’t Ayane or...Sensei Senseison, get the fuck out!
lines.zh: : 这关系到我点名的那两个人之间一个重要的获胜承诺！所以就算你是这里的老板，只要你不叫 Ayane 或者……Sensei Senseison，就他妈给我滚出去！

lines.en: if saralust20 == True and haruka_lust >= 25 and sara_lust >= 25:
: I’ll help you clean the place in the morning, Haru-chan. Besides, we’ve gotta get ready for {i}you know what{/i} anyway.
lines.zh: : Haru 酱，明天早上我帮你打扫。再说了，我们还得为{i}那件事{/i}做准备呢，你知道的。

lines.en: : Wait, are we actually doing that? I thought you were joking.
lines.zh: : 等等，我们真要干那个？我还以为你在开玩笑。

lines.en: : I’m serious if you’re serious.
lines.zh: : 你要是认真的，我也是认真的。

lines.en: : I’m always serious. Serious is my middle name. And my last name. I’m Haruka Serious Serious. That’s how serious I am.
lines.zh: : 我一直是认真的。认真是我的中间名。也是我的姓。我叫 Haruka·认真·认真。我就是这么认真。

lines.en: : Okay, I’ll shut up. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我闭嘴。走吧。

lines.en: else:
: Don’t worry, Haru-chan...I’ll help you clean the place in the morning.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Haru 酱……明天早上我会帮你打扫的。

lines.en: scene black
scene comedywaragain38
: Are you sure you want to do this now, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你确定要现在做这件事吗，Ayane？

lines.en: : A promise is a promise, right? You told me I could have something I wanted if I won the stand-up contest, and all I want is the answer to a question.
lines.zh: : 承诺就是承诺，对吧？你说过，如果我赢了单口相声比赛，我就能得到一件我想要的东西，而我想要的只是一个问题的答案。

lines.en: : Granted, I have a few {i}more{/i} questions after seeing your reaction to what Tsuneyo said at the end of her routine, but that’s something we can talk about later.
lines.zh: : 当然，看到你对 Tsuneyo 在段子最后那番话的反应之后，我又{i}多了{/i}几个问题，不过那个我们可以以后再谈。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不想——

lines.en: : It’s okay. {i}You’re{/i} okay.
lines.zh: : 没关系。{i}你{/i}已经很好了。

lines.en: : You’ve looked a little out of it since you got back from your date with Noriko. And I love you so much that I’d never want to make you do anything you’re uncomfortable with.
lines.zh: : 从你和 Noriko 约会回来之后，你就一直有点魂不守舍。而且我那么爱你，绝不会想逼你做让你不舒服的事。

lines.en: : But unfortunately, I {i}have{/i} to make you do something you’re uncomfortable with.
lines.zh: : 但遗憾的是，我{i}不得不{/i}逼你做一件让你不舒服的事。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because we had a deal.
lines.zh: : 因为我们有约在先。

lines.en: : And because, if I don’t do this, I’m going to go insane.
lines.zh: : 还因为，如果我不这么做，我会疯掉的。

lines.en: : That’s why I need peace of mind. And I can assure you that, no matter how uncomfortable {i}you{/i} feel about this, I am about to feel ten times {i}more{/i} uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 所以我需要内心的平静。而且我可以向你保证，不管这件事让{i}你{/i}有多不舒服，我接下来感受到的不舒服都会是你的{i}十倍{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re willing to hurt yourself just for peace of mind?
lines.zh: : 你愿意为了内心的平静，就这样伤害自己吗？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我愿意。

lines.en: : And I think you’d do the same.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得你也会愿意。

lines.en: : I’m tired of peeling this brave face off every time I’m alone...
lines.zh: : 我已经厌倦了每次独处时，都要把这张勇敢的脸从脸上撕下来……

lines.en: : Having to patch it up and plaster it back on every time I leave the house.
lines.zh: : 每次出门前，又得把它修补好、重新贴回去。

lines.en: : You are what keeps me tethered to this world. And, for my own sanity and safety, I am willing to sacrifice the illusion I have been blissfully living in for far too long now.
lines.zh: : 你是唯一把我拴在这个世界上的东西。而为了我自己的理智和安全，我愿意牺牲掉那个我已经幸福地活在其中的、维持太久的幻象。

lines.en: : It is going to hurt me. And I am going to cry very hard when I return to my room after this.
lines.zh: : 这会伤到我。而等这一切结束、我回到自己房间之后，我会哭得很厉害。

lines.en: : But I am going to smile the entire time I'm here.
lines.zh: : 但我在这里的每一秒，都会微笑着。

lines.en: : Because I know that having a front row seat to the death of this cheery facade will hurt {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为我知道，让你坐在前排亲眼看着这副快乐的面具死去，会伤到{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : What is it?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I don’t want to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 我不想伤害你。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : And even if we made a deal...I’m not going to answer some question that’s going to do that.
lines.zh: : 而且就算我们有约在先……我也不打算回答一个会那样伤害你的问题。

lines.en: : It’s either you hurt me a little bit now, or you hurt me a million times harder later.
lines.zh: : 要么你现在稍微伤我一点，要么以后用重上百万倍的方式伤我。

lines.en: : I can take it.
lines.zh: : 我受得住。

lines.en: : I’m strong.
lines.zh: : 我很坚强。

lines.en: : And like I said, you keep me tethered here.
lines.zh: : 而且就像我说的，是你把我拴在这里的。

lines.en: : So long as that fabric has a little bit of thread left, I’m going to hang on.
lines.zh: : 只要那块布还剩下一根线，我就会继续挂着。

lines.en: : Because I believe that one day, after all of this is over, there will be a future for the two of us.
lines.zh: : 因为我相信，总有一天，在这一切结束之后，我们两个会有一个未来。

lines.en: : The two of us alone.
lines.zh: : 只属于我们两个的未来。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain39
: And the first scraps of metal we need to craft the key to that future are right here inside of my bag.
lines.zh: : 而打造那把通往未来的钥匙所需要的第一批金属碎片，就在我的包里。

lines.en: : I’ve thought long and hard about how I want to do this. And I knew I needed some sort of push to be {i}able{/i} to as I always wind up backing down when I’m on the brink of telling you something big.
lines.zh: : 这件事该怎么做，我想了很久很久。而且我知道我需要某种推力{i}才能做到{/i}——因为每次到了要跟你说什么大事的关头，我总是会临阵退缩。

lines.en: : But this time, I’m not telling you anything at all.
lines.zh: : 但这一次，我什么都不会告诉你。

lines.en: : Because {i}you're{/i} the one who will be telling {i}me{/i} something.
lines.zh: : 因为这次要说点什么的人是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s why I’m able to find some semblance of courage despite being even more scared now than I was when we were on the roof.
lines.zh: : 也许这就是为什么，尽管我现在比我们在屋顶上时还要害怕，却能找到一点勇气的样子。

lines.en: : Heh...my hands are shaking like crazy.
lines.zh: : 呵……我的手抖得厉害。

lines.en: : I can barely even grab it.
lines.zh: : 我几乎都抓不住它。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : Before I give you what I’m about to give you...
lines.zh: : 在我把要给你的东西交给你之前……

lines.en: : I need to hear something.
lines.zh: : 我需要听你说一句话。

lines.en: : It’s something you've told me before and something I'll never get tired of hearing.
lines.zh: : 那是你以前对我说过的话，也是我永远都听不腻的话。

lines.en: : And while I’d like to say I’ll never make you say it again after this time, I know I’m wrong and that I’ll keep asking you to say it...over and over for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想说，这次之后我就再也不会让你说它了，但我知道我错了——我会一直要求你说，一遍又一遍，直到永远的尽头。

lines.en: : Again...and again...and again...
lines.zh: : 一遍……又一遍……又一遍……

lines.en: : I guess I actually am kind of crazy, huh?
lines.zh: : 我想我确实是有点疯了，对吧？

lines.en: : You’ve always been crazy.
lines.zh: : 你一直都是疯的。

lines.en: : I’ll always {i}be{/i} crazy.
lines.zh: : 我会一直{i}疯{/i}下去。

lines.en: : And I’ll always love you despite that.
lines.zh: : 而尽管如此，我也会一直爱你。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain40
: Heh...
: And I’ll always love you.
lines.zh: : 而我会一直爱你。

lines.en: : Thanks for saying it before I had to ask.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你在我开口求你之前就说了。

lines.en: : It steadied my hands long enough to give you these.
lines.zh: : 它让我的手稳住了，稳到足够把这些交给你。

lines.en: scene comedywaragain41
Ayane removes two simple objects from her bag and holds them out to me.
lines.zh: Ayane 从包里拿出两样简单的东西，递到我面前。

lines.en: The first is a mechanical pencil- the same one I’ve seen her using every day in class since the moment I first walked in.
lines.zh: 第一样是一支自动铅笔——从我第一天走进教室起，我就天天看见她在课上用着它。

lines.en: The second is just a sheet of paper.
lines.zh: 第二样只是一张纸。

lines.en: But it fills me with a sense of dread as I know what ends up on it will be the same thing that breaks her once she’s out of my reach.
lines.zh: 可它让我心里充满恐惧，因为我知道，最终写在那上面的东西，就是一旦她离开我的视线就会把她击碎的东西。

lines.en: And even if she’s able to piece herself back together, a part of me will be lost and never found.
lines.zh: 而就算她能把自己重新拼回去，我的某一部分也会就此丢失，再也找不回来。

lines.en: That’s just the way this body works.
lines.zh: 这具身体就是这么运作的。

lines.en: That’s just the way I’m wired.
lines.zh: 我就是被这样接线的。

lines.en: : It’s blank.
lines.zh: : 是空白的。

lines.en: : For now.
lines.zh: : 暂时是。

lines.en: : You want me to write my answer down instead of just telling you?
lines.zh: : 你想让我把答案写下来，而不是直接告诉你？

lines.en: : I figure that will be easiest for both of us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样对我们俩都最容易。

lines.en: : You don’t like talking and I don’t like listening.
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢说，而我不喜欢听。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Sensei. But my question isn’t really a {i}question{/i} at all.
lines.zh: : 对不起，老师。但我的问题其实根本不是{i}问题{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s a command.
lines.zh: : 是一道命令。

lines.en: : A command that you, my knight in shining armor, must fulfill.
lines.zh: : 一道你——我的白马骑士——必须完成的命令。

lines.en: : And that command is?
lines.zh: : 那么那道命令是？

lines.en: A moment of silence spreads between us.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默在我们之间蔓延。

lines.en: In that time, Ayane surely thinks about backing down once again.
lines.zh: 在那段时间里，Ayane 肯定又想过要打退堂鼓。

lines.en: But she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 但她没有。

lines.en: And so I have to hurt her.
lines.zh: 所以我必须伤害她。

lines.en: : Make me a list.
lines.zh: : 给我列一张名单。

lines.en: : Of what?
lines.zh: : 列什么？

lines.en: : Everyone.
lines.zh: : 所有人。

lines.en: : Everyone wh-
lines.zh: : 所有人什——

lines.en: : You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你懂我的意思。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : I need to know.
lines.zh: : 我必须知道。

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 确定。

lines.en: : You’re not going to like what you see...
lines.zh: : 你不会喜欢你看到的东西……

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : But it will all be worth it in the end.
lines.zh: : 但到头来一切都会值得的。

lines.en: : I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我确信。

lines.en: scene black
I pull the blank sheet of paper from her hands.
lines.zh: 我从她手里抽走那张白纸。

lines.en: Then the pencil.
lines.zh: 然后是那支铅笔。

lines.en: But before I fill the page with everyone-
lines.zh: 但在我把那一页写满所有人之前——

lines.en: I reach into my pocket for a pen.
lines.zh: 我把手伸进口袋，掏出一支钢笔。

lines.en: And I scratch her name in ink along the top of it.
lines.zh: 然后在纸的最顶端，用墨水写下她的名字。
